academic.title: Agentic Heuristic Design for Optimization

academic.title: Agent Harness Optimization and Evaluation
academic.summary: Harnesses—the scaffolding around LLM agents—are being optimized via curriculum learning, provenance enforcement, and process-level evaluation. This is hot because harness quality dominates real-world agent performance.

academic.title: Efficiency Gaps in LLM Optimization Modeling
academic.summary: Studies reveal that LLMs solving optimization problems produce correct but costly models, exposing a trade-off between accuracy and computational efficiency that limits practical deployment.

academic.title: Neural Combinatorial Optimization with Memory
academic.summary: Graph neural and memory-augmented methods tackle combinatorial optimization under hard information horizons, with selective memory propagation improving solution quality across routing and assignment tasks.

academic.title: Agentic Frameworks for Scientific Discovery
academic.summary: Agentic systems now automate many-body simulations, inverse design of materials, and formal verification, accelerating scientific workflows by coupling LLM reasoning with domain-specific tools.
